AccessPolicy.description:
Relational permission view: null is the explicit wildcard, distinct from an
empty selection. These generated wire models confer no actor authority.

agent.description: The engine's product name, as Cairn's status reported it.

credits.description: Codex's own credit objects, kept verbatim.

items.description: Validated against the selected package's manifest, never used for Cairn policy.

AccountSignInProgress.description: Progress of an owner-started sign-in, never its challenge or credential.

attemptedAt.description: The last reading attempt, successful or not (Claude Code and OpenCode Go).

usedPercent.description: Kept as reported, so integer readings stay integers.

nodePriorities.description: Preferred placement order. This does not grant access to any node.
Preferred placement order. This does not grant access to any node.

AuditEntry.description: One recorded installation change; `detail` is the JSON recorded with it.

startup.description: The adapter confirmed that no new agent turn was submitted.

resolvedModel.description: Claude's resolved model behind a subscription alias.

serviceTiers.description: None means unknown, distinct from a known empty speed list.

project.description: Omission inherits the requester project. An explicit choice can clear it.

reason.description: The engine's reason code, such as `overloaded` or `rate_limit`.

runId.description: Wire UUID for an existing run; distinct from a mission/task identifier.

entries.description: Timeline cards that first appeared within this page or last changed in it.

largeEntries.description: Oversized timeline cards, fetched in bounded chunks before this page is applied.

location.description: Validated against the selected package's manifest, never used for Cairn policy.

ListAuditOutput.description: The 100 most recent entries, newest first.

oneOf.description: The package-defined view/action result has already passed its manifest validator.

McpTool.description: Public projection of a third-party tool. Schemas remain opaque JSON.

McpView.description: Current connection state. Tool descriptors are third-party protocol JSON.

tools.description: Tool catalog as returned by the server.

OutcomeAsideAction.description:
How an account sets a blocked mission outcome aside. Each applies until the
mission finishes again; input the agent asked for can only be snoozed.

OutcomeDismissal.description: An outcome set aside by the calling account: dismissed (`until` null) or snoozed.

values.description: Validated against the selected package's manifest, never used for Cairn policy.

PluginAgentAccess.description: Agents the owner grants on each instance may run the package's commands and tools.

PluginArgument.description: One flag (`--vault ID`) or positional value of a command. Values are text.

pattern.description: A regular expression the whole value must match.

resourceType.description: The resource type identified by this argument.

PluginBrand.description: The package's mark: a background colour and an SVG path on a 24×24 grid.

PluginCommand.description: A command agents run in their conversation: `cairn plugin <plugin> <name> …`.

PluginCondition.description:
A condition granted agents can wait for with `wait_for`, observed by the `condition`
handler. Its type is `<plugin>_<name>`, like a tool name.

project.description: Pinned to one of the run's projects: Cairn checks it is authorized and passes it.

PluginConfiguration.description:
Full Cairn configuration, with manifest settings and secret fields separate.
Missing agentIds retains grants; agents are forbidden from submitting it at all.

revision.description: Required on replacement. Creation has no existing revision.

secrets.description: Validated against the selected package's manifest, never used for Cairn policy.

settings.description: Validated against the selected package's manifest, never used for Cairn policy.

PluginConnection.description: Explicit owner/agent view: no credential, approved policy or native provenance.

settings.description: Validated against the selected package's manifest, never used for Cairn policy.

PluginCredential.description:
How the host injects a connection's secret into authorized HTTP requests.
Plugin code never receives the secret itself.

deviceFlow.description: The owner may sign in instead of pasting the credential.

oauth.description: Authorization-code sign-in with PKCE and host-owned refresh tokens.

PluginDeviceFlow.description:
OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant (RFC 8628), run by the host for the owner.
The token obtained becomes the instance's credential; scripts never see it.

authorizationUrl.description: Where the host asks for a device and user code. HTTPS on a declared host.

clientId.description: The public client ID of the package publisher's OAuth application.

tokenUrl.description: Where the host polls for the token. HTTPS on a declared host.

secrets.description: Validated against the selected package's manifest, never used for Cairn policy.

settings.description: Validated against the selected package's manifest, never used for Cairn policy.

values.description: Validated against the selected package's manifest, never used for Cairn policy.

PluginGitCredential.description: Git credentials for one HTTPS remote prefix, kept in a store file Cairn owns.

PluginGitIdentity.description: The commit author of runs, when the installation has no global Git identity.

PluginInstances.description: How the owner's interfaces name one configured instance, e.g. "Service account".

conditions.description: Conditions granted agents wait for, observed by the `condition` handler.

description.description: One sentence shown in the owner's plugin catalogue.

hosts.description:
Hostnames reachable through `http` (HTTPS) and `socket` (WSS). `*.example.com`
covers every subdomain of `example.com`, not the domain itself.

instanceForm.description:
The script's `form` handler fills dynamic choices, derived values, errors and
guidance while the owner edits an instance, and checks it before it is saved.

instanceTest.description: The script's `test` handler checks an instance.

instanceView.description: The script's `view` handler describes each instance's panel.

instructions.description: Added to the prompt of runs whose agent is granted on an enabled instance.

projectSources.description: Projects the owner can import through the `projects` handler.

runCredentials.description: Files, Git credentials and identity rendered into granted agents' runs.

secretPatterns.description: Regular expressions of the service's token formats, masked in run output.

settings.description: Instance fields Cairn renders, in order: `[{ key, title, type, ... }]`.

setup.description: What connecting an instance takes and the steps the owner follows.

skillSources.description: Skill sources the owner imports from through the `skills` handler.

PluginOAuth.description:
A provider-independent authorization-code flow. Client settings and secrets are
declared form fields; credentials and PKCE material never enter package code.

scopeSettings.description: Additional scopes for enabled boolean settings, e.g. sending or deletion.

PluginProgram.description: A program on the installation the package may run through `exec`.

cache.description: Optional foreground cache daemon, isolated to a saved instance and revision.

installer.description: Package-relative Luau module exporting `resolve` and `install` handlers.

path.description: Absolute path, approved by the owner with the package.

daemonArgs.description: Static arguments to the same executable. It must remain in the foreground.

socketEnv.description: Cairn supplies a private Unix socket path to the daemon and its clients.

PluginProjectSource.description: Where the owner imports projects from: the `projects` handler lists and resolves them.

path.description: JSON Pointer through properties; `*` traverses array items.

PluginResourceRef.description: A resource identity is scoped to a plugin instance and a declared type.

PluginRunCredentials.description:
Rendered by the host for granted agents, when their run is prepared or resumed, and
for its own Git fetches of matching remotes. Removed when the run ends or the grant
is withdrawn.

PluginRunFile.description: A file Cairn writes in the home of each run whose agent is granted an instance.

path.description: Relative to the run's home, e.g. `.config/tool/hosts.yml`.

nameFrom.description: A string setting naming a new instance once known, e.g. the verified mailbox.

summary.description: What the owner needs before connecting, in one or two sentences.

PluginSkillSource.description:
Where the owner imports skills from: the `skills` handler resolves a location and
lists its files, which the host downloads.

fields.description: The location form, like instance settings: `string`, `url` or `text` fields.

PluginTool.description: A tool listed by the run's Cairn MCP server. Input is checked against the schema.

id.description: Wire UUID for an existing run; distinct from a mission/task identifier.

runId.description: Wire UUID for an existing run; distinct from a mission/task identifier.

current.description: The latest limit of the current turn or execution, until work moves on.

message.description: The engine's own report of the limit.

resetsAt.description: When the engine said the limit resets.

finishedAt.description: When the work the account saw finished. Later work stays unread.

entryId.description: Read a complete interpreted timeline card instead of a raw event.

runId.description: Wire UUID for an existing run; distinct from a mission/task identifier.
Wire UUID for an existing run; distinct from a mission/task identifier.

before.description: Cards that first appeared before this position; the newest page by default.

changes.description: Resume the change feed from a cursor returned by this operation.

runId.description: Wire UUID for an existing run; distinct from a mission/task identifier.

snapshot.description: Pin older pages to the first page's cursor. A change requires restarting.

ReadTarget.description: Work an account can read: a conversation's latest turn or a mission's latest run.

ancestors.description: Nearest parent first, through the root. Cairn resolves each parent itself.

runId.description: Wire UUID for an existing run; distinct from a mission/task identifier.
Wire UUID for an existing run; distinct from a mission/task identifier.

RunEvent.description: The event's ordering identity is distinct from a client's presentation identity.

displayId.description: Client cache identity; never supplied by the event writer.

payload.description: Redacted adapter JSON, retained without constructing a second object tree.

timeline.description:
The timeline presents this event. Clients render it only through its
card and read it as a boundary of families that are not converted yet.

RunEventPage.description:
An oversized event retains its cursor, while its exact JSON remains available
through read_run_content. No success-shaped partial event is returned.

run.description: Existing byte-bounded preview; full metadata is read through read_run_content.

RunHistoryWindowOutput.description: Agent windows use bounded previews; UI history retains its full event frames.

runId.description: Wire UUID for an existing run; distinct from a mission/task identifier.

RunMetadataPage.description:
A byte-bounded metadata page is either complete or an explicit preview. The
full record remains available through read_run_content in either case.

RunState.description:
Lifecycle fields have one SQL authority. Engine/node/chat payloads are adapted
separately at their domain boundaries, never merged into this state.

RunTaskSnapshot.description:
Presentation of task settings in a run snapshot. Chats synthesize the same typed
settings without creating a mission or a scheduled commitment.

RunTimelineOutput.description: Tool windows use the same cards with explicit previews for oversized content.

changeCursor.description: Save the first page's cursor, then request changes after loading the pages.

oldest.description: Pass as `before` for the previous page while hasOlder is true.

SaveStorageSettingsInput.description: Credentials are written to the installation's private storage file only.

privateBucketConfirmed.description: Required for Cloudflare R2: public domains and bucket locks are disabled.

data.description: Base64 PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 5 MiB before normalization.

SetupPreset.description: A named combination of the step's boolean settings, e.g. "Read only".

values.description: Settings turned on. The step's other boolean settings are turned off.

settings.description: Keys of the settings this step shows, in order.

shared.description:
The same values serve every instance, e.g. one OAuth client for every mailbox.
A new instance can reuse them from another one (`sharedFrom`): the host copies
them, secrets included, without sending secrets to the client.

warning.description: A consequence to know before going on, e.g. a provider's token expiry.

SetupTask.description: Something the owner does on the service's site, ticked off in the assistant.

link.description: The link's label, e.g. "Open API Library".

url.description: The service's page for this task. HTTPS.

location.description: Validated against the selected package's manifest, never used for Cairn policy.

StorageCheck.description: A completed write, read and deletion of a probe object. Failures are errors.

StorageSettings.description: The default S3 storage for new disks, without its credentials.

runId.description: Wire UUID for an existing run; distinct from a mission/task identifier.

TimelineChange.description:
A live change of one card. A stream sends `append` only for a reply whose text
grows after the text it already delivered; any other change sends the card.

oneOf.description:
A message the person sent, as delivered to the agent. A private answer
arrives as its placeholder; the answer itself never enters the timeline.

sentAt.description: When the person sent it, at or before its delivery.

oneOf.description: The agent's reply. Successive snapshots of the same reply replace its text.

echo.description:
The reply only repeats a failure or usage limit the conversation already
reports; a conversation omits it, the run log keeps it.

via.description: The model provider that wrote this reply, when the engine chose among several.

TimelineCursor.description: A cursor over card revisions, bound to the retained event history.

id.description: None means all cards at this revision have been delivered.

TimelineEntry.description:
One card of a run's timeline. Its identity is stable across pages, turns and
reconnections; a newer revision of the same card replaces the older one.

attempt.description: Execution attempts Cairn started before the card, after the first one.

position.description: Event sequence where the card first appeared. Pages are ordered by position.

revision.description:
Change cursor: the event sequence of the card's latest change, distinct
from its position. A card changed by a later event keeps its position.

source.description: The event holding the card's current content; read it whole with read_run_content.

turn.description: Engine turns started before the card, counted from the run's first event.

oneOf.description: The card's identity and cursor; read the card by entryId with read_run_content.

TimelineNotice.description:
What a lifecycle, error or retry card reports. Clients localize the code and
its arguments; `detail` is only ever content reported by the work itself.

detail.description: The engine's or worker's own words, such as a failure reason or stderr.

level.description: An engine notice's level, as the engine reports it.

origin.description: Where a failure was reported: the turn, the run, the engine or the runner.

prominent.description: A conversation shows the card. Other cards remain in the run log only.

quota.description: The engine stopped on the account's usage limit.

recovered.description: Work continued after this interruption or engine retry.

retried.description: Automatic retries Cairn made before this failure repeated.

retry.description: Cairn scheduled this retry of the failure; it has not started yet.

status.description: The run status a `runStatus` card reports.

tasks.description: Background tasks a turn waits for.

kind.description: The card's kind: userMessage, agentMessage or notice.

resetsAt.description: When the window resets. A limit no longer applies afterwards.

status.description: The provider's status, such as `allowed`, `allowed_warning` or `rejected`.

WaitForOutput.description: The common workspace response; extension data stays in the typed observation.
